title: Yellowed Crunchy Russian Beet Skillet
description: A lazy Sunday Russian dish featuring bitter and crunchy beets with a sweet brown sugar flavor, perfect for a relaxing afternoon meal. This egg-free friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced beets with olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and add the beet mixture.
Cook the beets for 5 minutes on each side, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Sprinkle the brown sugar over the beets and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated broiler and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the beets are caramelized and crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh dill, if desired.
Serve the beets hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
